name: enrich-details
title_zh: 黑胶入库后自动补全 Discogs 全字段详情
tagline_zh: 同步完新唱片却只看到标题和封面？这个技能自动抓取曲目、厂牌、风格、国家与备注，写进 details.json。
tagline_en: After syncing new records, this fetches tracklist, label, genre, country, notes from Discogs and saves them to.
desc_en: Fetch tracklist, label, genre, country, and notes for records from Discogs and store them in data/details.json. Use after sync-collection has added new records, or when the user wants richer detail-card content for records that show "not enriched yet".
why_zh: 它不替代同步流程，而是精准补上「同步后缺详情」那一格——按需触发，只处理未富集的记录。
why_en: It doesn't replace sync—it fills the exact gap after it. Triggered on demand, only for records flagged 'not enriched yet', with.
limit_zh: 仅当本地已有 data/collection.json 且包含 Discogs ID 时可用。
limit_en: Requires existing data/collection.json with Discogs IDs. Skips manual entries without IDs. Writes only details.json—no UI. Fails offline.
title_en: Fetch full Discogs details for unenriched vinyl records
